_doc: Pacing templates: intro = the stretch before the first gate; finale = the closing wave after the pre-boss gate (default 'finale': climax-tier segments); intervals = one enemy role for each space after a regular gate (one per gate, see generator.cadence.gate_count). Gate positions are fixed; templates only change what you fight between them. Reward levels turn a pressure interval into a breather; spike levels do the opposite.
